character: An old man, olive scales gone grey along the jaw, one eye milky white, the other dark and calm. Heavy-lidded, a slow blink. Stooped, unhurried.
wardrobe: A faded sailor's waistcoat and loose trousers, a ring of keys and a purse at his belt, no weapon.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's deck, both hands resting on a walking stick.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Standing over a dead pirate captain on a deck, one clawed hand raised, a crowd of pirates around him raising their hands to vote.
